description: This PHP source file defines the BearerTokenValidator class, which implements OAuth2 authorization validation logic within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It validates access tokens received in HTTP requests using the League OAuth2 server library, handling token decryption, existence, revocation, and expiry.

classes.name: BearerTokenValidator
classes.description: Class responsible for validating OAuth2 Bearer tokens received via HTTP authorization headers. It checks for token existence, decryption, revocation, and expiry, and attaches the valid token to the request.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the access token repository and sets the encryption key used for decrypting tokens.

methods.name: validateAuthorization
methods.description: Validates the 'Authorization' header in the incoming server request, decrypts the token, verifies its validity, checks for revocation and expiry, and attaches the OAuth access token to the request if valid.
